svg.title: dex.place layout 1, the Pilgrimage Loop: map to scale and pacing chart
svg.text: Side-view map drawn to scale in H (player height, 80 world px). Height is altitude above the lake. One screen = 16 x 9 H (box at lower right).
Interiors behind doors (Ferry House, Archive) are drawn just below their doors. The route runs left to right; branches go up or down; shortcuts close the loop.
S3 rope bridge, cut from the far side
S4 the chapel door: lift the latch inside the chapel and it opens into the Ferry House, beside the dock
shortcut, opened from the far side
Pacing along the route: vast vs cozy, tense vs calm
Design intent on one 0 to 1 scale, in walking order (the gallery run with the spire branch taken). Every vast peak is followed by a small room; both tense peaks end in a quiet one.
Numbers match the room tables and the pacing table in layout-1.md. Hover a column for its values. Plan draft; nothing is built.
